description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'SaveQualificationSkillController' within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling the pre-render logic for qualification skill save and edit views in the admin plugin module.

classes.name: SaveQualificationSkillController
classes.description: A controller to manage the rendering of qualification skill save/edit components, extending the AbstractVueController base class.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering; it determines if an existing qualification skill is being edited or a new one is being created based on the request and sets the appropriate component with properties.
